entities.name: Nyxborn
entities.description: Creatures with night-sky skin of many shapes, once emissaries of the gods, who attack a bridge-gate and slaughter the narrator's company.

entities.name: Akroan soldiers
entities.description: The soldiers of Akros, whom the narrator was forced to join after being caught stealing.

entities.name: Kytheon Iora
entities.description: A legendary hero who with his irregulars fought the cyclops at Akros, whose tactics the narrator echoes.

entities.name: Vinack
entities.description: A legendary hero said to have felled a cyclops by reflecting sunlight into its eye.

entities.name: Aesrias
entities.description: A hero of Iroas who knocked out the heads of a hydra so they would not multiply.

entities.name: Solon
entities.description: A man said to have braved a labyrinth to retrieve Dekella, the bident of Thassa.

entities.name: Dekella
entities.description: The bident of Thassa, retrieved from a labyrinth by Solon in legend.

entities.name: King Kedarick VI
entities.description: A king of Iretis who tore out his own eyes so he would not see his wife and son murdered by leonin.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead, whom the narrator imagines lording over the battle with her as his nemesis.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: The guide of the dead, who the narrator thinks did not attend her passing.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: A god whose bident Dekella is the subject of Solon's legend.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: A god of whom Aesrias is called the hero.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: A god whose temple the narrator is taken to for healing.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: The city where Kytheon Iora and his irregulars fought a cyclops.

entities.name: Iretis
entities.description: The realm of King Kedarick VI.

events.summary: Caught stealing from a magister's study, the narrator is forced to choose between joining the Akroan soldiers and execution.
events.quote: I could join the noble Akroan soldiers, or I could be executed.

events.summary: The narrator recalls the legends of heroes such as Vinack, Aesrias, Solon and Kedarick VI that inspired her as an orphan thief.
events.quote: Even as a young thief outside of the academies, you learned about the great heroes.

events.summary: As an orphan on the streets the narrator resolves to become a legend greater than Kytheon Iora.
events.quote: I would be greater than Kytheon.

events.summary: As a soldier the narrator proves an excellent fighter and is soon to become an officer with her own contingent.
events.quote: In a few months, I was to become an officer with a contingent of my own.

events.summary: Word comes that the Nyxborn are attacking, and the narrator rushes with her company to the gate.
The Nyxborn force of mixed creatures with night-sky skin approaches the bridge, and the narrator realizes they are agents of the gods.
events.quote: These were agents of the gods sent to do their bidding.

events.summary: The narrator realizes she has rushed into battle with only seven other soldiers against an army of unknown size.
events.quote: I had rushed into a fight against an army of unknown size and strength with only seven other soldiers.

events.summary: The soldiers hold the bridge in a phalanx, knocking Nyxborn off the edge, until weak reinforcements arrive and the gates are sealed behind them.
events.quote: Reinforcements arrived and the guards sealed the gates behind them

events.summary: A Nyxborn grabs and stabs the narrator six times and throws her against the sealed gates.
events.quote: thrown like a child's toy against the gates that didn't open.

events.summary: The Nyxborn retreat after the last soldier falls, and the gates reopen.
events.quote: And then, as the last soldier fell, the Nyxborn retreated.

events.summary: Clerics rescue the narrator, relieving her collapsed lung with a hollow reed, healing her with magic and taking her to a Pharikan temple.
The narrator concludes that the battle was pointless and that maybe true heroes let their names fade away.
events.quote: Maybe true heroes just let their names fade away.

relations.note: Kytheon led irregulars who fought the cyclops at Akros.
relations.quote: Everyone knows the stories of Kytheon Iora and his irregulars

relations.note: The Nyxborn attack and slaughter the Akroan company.
